page_title: LAZ 2-1 SAS | Lazio v Sassuolo 09/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+2' 2 - 1 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Matteo Cancellieri is pounced on by Adam Marusic (Lazio). His close-range header flashes past Arijanet Muric and into the roof of the net. 2:1.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) takes a free kick from the edge of the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
88' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
87' Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) makes a terrific run to get on the end of the free kick and powers a header just over the bar from close in.
87' Lazio are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
86' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.

84' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Arijanet Muric is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
83' Darryl Bakola (Sassuolo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ismael Kone.
83' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Arijanet Muric is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
81' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
81' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the bottom right corner, but Edoardo Motta keeps it out with an amazing save.

81' A neat pass is well received by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
79' Here is a change. Gustav Isaksen is going off and Maurizio Sarri gives the last tactical orders to Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio).
79' The referee allows time for a substitution. Mattia Zaccagni will be replaced by Pedro (Lazio).
79' What a big chance! Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
77' Wonderful movement by Lazio. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
75' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
74' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. Sassuolo will take a corner kick.
74' The ball is cleared after Josh Doig (Sassuolo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Sassuolo will take a corner.

71' A sweet pass finds Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Arijanet Muric is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
69' Substitution. Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) in, Woyo Coulibaly out.
68' Fabio Grosso has decided to substitute Ulisses Garcia and he is replaced by Josh Doig (Sassuolo).
68' Fabio Grosso has decided to make a change. Luca Moro (Sassuolo) replaces M'Bala Nzola.
68' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is caught offside!
67' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
65' The manager makes a subsitution with Boulaye Dia (Lazio) coming on for Daniel Maldini.

61' Ambitious effort from Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
59' Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
58' Yellow card. Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
56' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Alberto Arena blows his whistle for an infringement.
54' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) passes the ball onto Daniel Maldini, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
52' The resulting corner from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) comes to nothing.
51' Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Sassuolo will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
49' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Maurizio Sarri gives a chance to Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) and Alessio Romagnoli is off.
46' The game has come to an end for Luca Lipani. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Alberto Arena blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
44' Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
44' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
41' Sassuolo are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
38' Maurizio Sarri is forced to make a change. Danilo Cataldi is unable to continue due to injury, Patric (Lazio) comes on.
37' Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) has tested the patience of referee Alberto Arena and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
35' 1 - 1 Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) receives a precise pass inside the box from Kristian Thorstvedt and he beats the goalkeeper with a brilliant shot into the top right corner. 1:1.
34' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
32' Foul! Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
28' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
28' Sassuolo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

27' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The linesman makes the right call and Sassuolo will have a corner.
26' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
26' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is flagged for offside.
24' Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
22' Adam Marusic (Lazio) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
20' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

17' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
16' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Lazio force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
15' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
12' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just wide of the right post.
8' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.

5' Lazio slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
2' 1 - 0 Goal! Daniel Maldini (Lazio) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 1:0.
2' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) shoots from inside the box after his amazing individual effort. He beats the goalkeeper, but hits one of the defending players and it bounces away.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Lazio will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Alberto Arena.
